saw_lines: Dog parents don’t shop toys by looks. They buy whatever survives their chewer, then rebuy the same brand once it has.
So the sale is decided in the first line, where a new buyer checks delivery and the offer, or scrolls past.
Your site shows 145,000+ Happy Families and 5,000+ reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Put one of them on every creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 145,000+ Happy Families and 5,000+ reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number, so cold buyers have no proof to act on. Put one number on every creative and open two ads with a review quote.

Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer leaves with the question open. Put the free shipping offer and delivery time in the first line of three new ads.
The offer appears after 58% of the copy on a median ad of 75 words, so most readers never reach it. Move the offer into the first two lines of every ad and cut the copy to the point.

3 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product on screen, so each click needs another search. Point each of those three ads to the product it shows, the same way your other Shop now ads already do.

ads_1: Customer review video ads for power chewers, opening on the free shipping offer
